items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Retain no new proposals or change requests this cycle. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission of $0 does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28: 4,926 calls, 228 errors, 5 transient errors, and $901.90 cost, or approximately $0.183 per call. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and costs are not period-aligned, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are absent, monthly budget ceilings are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold exists. The 30-day scorecard shows 39 improvements awaiting measurement, 8 failed requests, and only 2 proven outcomes; treatment output of 70 versus 44 controls is activity, not financial or causal lift. Continue only the existing reconciliation and containment work using recorded telemetry; do not forecast revenue or authorize spend, commitments, monetization expansion, deployment, new telemetry, or requeues.

Minimum evidence remains: reconcile provider revenue to site, content, and tracking identifiers for the same period as AI and other costs; preserve aggregate provider rows as unattributed; reconcile all recorded cost categories; record approved budget ceilings; and define the learning outcome and maximum cost-to-learn. Use the existing financial reconciliation work item and do not create duplicate telemetry work.
